usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks, and Ryver shares each new one with the team through “Send Chat Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Send Chat Message” in Ryver
bestTemplate.why: A task added to a project posts a message to the team chat you choose.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” is polling, so the chat message arrives after a scheduled check.
